name: com.fwbjobs/jobs
title: FullTime with Benefits jobs
description: Search open jobs and companies in Europe, Morocco and the Gulf. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches the open job postings listed on FullTime with Benefits (fwbjobs.com): employers' own postings from their careers sites and public job centres, in Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Luxembourg, Monaco, Morocco, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and the United Arab Emirates. Returns up to 20 jobs a call, title matches first (or newest first, or by pay), each with its FWB link and its original posting's link. Results are in each posting's own language. No totals.

query.description: Words to find in job titles, required skills and company names; a plural finds the singular too ("accountants"). Separate independent terms with commas: every term must be found ("react, typescript"). A term of several words is a phrase ("sales manager"). Leave out to list by place and filters alone.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the job is in, e.g. DE.

city.description: A city's name in English or as locals write it (Munich or München). Give country too when the name is ambiguous.

radius_km.description: With city: also the cities within this distance.

min_salary_eur.description: Only jobs whose pay comes to at least this much a year in euros (rounded down to a thousand). Jobs without a pay in euros are left out.

language.description: Only postings written in this language.

sort.description: relevance (the default with query): jobs of a company named exactly so first, then title matches, then skill matches, then company-name matches, newest first within each. newest (the default without query): by the day the employer posted the job. salary: highest yearly pay in euros first, only jobs that state one.

limit.description: How many jobs a page holds at most: up to this many.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous answer, with the same other arguments, for the next page.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns one open job listed on FullTime with Benefits with the posting's full text in its own language, the address to apply at and the employer's original posting.

job.description: The job's id from search_jobs or company_jobs, or its fwbjobs.com link.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Finds companies that have a public page on FullTime with Benefits by a word of their name. Returns up to 8, with the number of their open jobs.

name.description: A word of the company's name, or its start.

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: Returns a company's public page on FullTime with Benefits: what it says about itself and its newest open jobs (up to 20).

company.description: A slug from search_companies, or a job's company_url.
